direction.name: The object, large
direction.idea: Show the thing, bigger than seems reasonable. One photographed object fills the first screen, scaled until the viewport crops it, with the text small and tucked beside or behind it. The crop is the idea: a record whose edge leaves the top-right corner, a bottle whose shoulder runs off the bottom, a chair seen so close you read its grain. Being that close reads as confidence in the object. Everything else on the page serves it: details as tight close-ups, facts as short lines, one way to buy.
direction.composition: First screen: the object occupies 55–75% of the viewport and breaks at least one edge. It sits on a flat field (ground colour or one bold colour), never in a box. The headline is short and either very large and partly hidden behind the object (10–13vw, the object overlapping two or three letters) or small (28–36px) in the opposite corner with a one-line description. No navigation bar beyond a wordmark and one action. Following sections: a row of three or four close-up details at different crop ratios (not equal tiles), a single wide photograph of the object in use, a plain list of facts set large (materials, size, price) aligned to one edge, then the purchase action. The object returns once at the end from a different angle.
direction.typography: Either very large and structural or very small and precise; pick one for the headline and hold it. Facts are set in the text face at 22–28px, not in a table.
direction.colour: A flat field chosen to make the object's own colour sing (its complement, or a tone darker than its shadow side). One field for the whole page, or a second for the facts section.
direction.imagery: Use the product's own photographs if they exist. Otherwise use a still-life from the dealt set as a stand-in and say so. Prefer images with a plain background; use `mix-blend-mode: multiply` on light fields so a white studio background disappears into the page colour.
direction.photoTreatment: Scale the main image well past its container (`width: 120–160%`) and let `overflow: hidden` on the section do the cropping.
direction.richness: The object's surface at close range, and the tension of the crop.
direction.pitfalls: A small centred product shot with space all round is a catalogue thumbnail, not this direction. If the image has a busy background it cannot sit on a field; crop tighter or change image. Keep text off the object's focal area.

hero.name: Single object on a plinth
hero.blueprint: An off-white screen that is about 80% empty and does not need to scroll. One photographed object stands dead centre: a studio shot on a plain background, shown 440px tall (about half the viewport height) whatever its width, with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so its backdrop disappears into the page. It rests on a plinth, a rounded square 520px across filled one step lighter than the page and centred behind it, with no border. The wordmark sits top-left at a 56px margin in a heavy serif or grotesk, about 400px wide (28% of the viewport) and 80px tall; it is the only large type. Opposite it, top-right on the same margin and aligned to the wordmark's top, sits the one supporting sentence at 15px, right-aligned, max 36ch. Centred 40px under the plinth is the single action: a compact email field or button 240px wide with 8px corners. Further objects replace the first in the same position by crossfade, each scaled to the same visual mass. There is no navigation. Nothing else touches the edges, and the object never grows beyond half the viewport height.
hero.mobile: The wordmark sits top-left at 44vw wide with 20px margins and the supporting sentence drops beneath it at 14px. The plinth is 78vw square, centred at 54% of the height, with the object 44svh tall on it. The action sits 32px under the plinth, 40px in from each side. The screen stays mostly empty and the objects swap in place.
hero.headline: None beyond the name: the wordmark top-left, up to about 10 characters, is the only large type and the object is the statement.

photos.title: Hands and making
photos.note: hands at work, craft and making
photos.treatment: Scale the main image well past its container (`width: 120–160%`) and let `overflow: hidden` on the section do the cropping.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Heading captions a panorama
sections.blueprint: The section is exactly 100svh. Its top third holds a two-line heading of three to six words at clamp(48px, 6.5vw, 96px) with leading 0.95, either centred or flush left on the page margin. 28px beneath the heading sit two small captions side by side, each two lines at 13px and 150px wide with a 48px gap, aligned to the heading (centred as a pair, or both starting at its left edge). 40px below them a full-bleed photograph begins and runs off the bottom of the viewport: it is 100vw wide at 21:9 or wider, and only its top 55–60svh is visible before the fold, the rest arriving with scroll. The heading therefore reads as a large caption to the picture. On an object-led page the image is the object on a flat dark panel inset by the page margin instead of bleeding to the edges.
sections.mobile: Heading at 12vw on two lines, left-aligned, taking the top 30% of the screen. The two captions merge into one four-line block at 14px. The photograph begins at 45% of the screen height in a 4:5 crop, full-bleed, and runs off the bottom.

sections.name: Tiles that grow
sections.blueprint: Order is carried by size. Three flat colour tiles stand in one row, bottom-aligned (align-items: end) with 10px gaps, each larger than the one before: columns 1–3 at 30vh tall, columns 4–7 at 44vh, columns 8–12 at 60vh. Each tile holds one photograph of the subject at that stage (raw, in progress, finished), centred and scaled so the object grows from tile to tile; on light tiles mix-blend-mode: multiply removes a white studio background. One palette colour per tile. Text sits under the tiles, outside them, aligned to each tile's left edge: a stage name at 20px medium whose wording carries the order ('Picked', 'Pressed', 'Poured') and two lines at 16px in the soft ink. The heading, two to four words at 40–52px, occupies the empty ground above the two smaller tiles, top-aligned with the tallest tile. A fourth stage is possible with spans of 2, 3, 3 and 4 columns.
sections.mobile: Tiles stack in order and grow in height instead: 34vw, 46vw and 62vw tall, each at full width. The name and text sit under each tile at 18px and 16px. The heading comes first at 30px. 28px between stages.

sections.name: Shape-marked small points
sections.blueprint: For the many minor points that do not deserve a row each. Columns 1–5: one photograph inside a single large shape taken from the subject's own geometry (a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), made with clip-path or border-radius, about 78svh tall and pushed 12% past the section's left edge so the viewport crops it. Columns 7–12: the heading, two to four words at 40–48px, then 56px lower a grid of eight to twelve points in three columns with 40px column gaps and 44px row gaps, no cells and no fills. Each point is a title at 17px medium preceded by the same shape drawn at cap height (0.7em, flat fill, inline SVG or a styled span), then two lines at 15px in the soft ink. The small shapes take a different palette colour per column, which is the only colour on the right side.
sections.mobile: The shaped photograph comes first, 82vw wide, cropped by the left edge and no taller than 60svh. The heading follows at 30px. Points become one column with 28px between them; the small shape hangs in the margin to the left of each title, so titles and text share one edge.

sections.name: Names running off the edges
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed band in a flat colour, about 34vh tall, holding a single line of names that is cropped by both viewport edges. The names are set at 8vw in the display weight, `white-space: nowrap`, separated by a solid round dot one third of the cap height, and the line moves slowly to the left (a CSS `translateX` animation over 40 seconds on a duplicated track, paused under `prefers-reduced-motion`). The band has no heading. Its meaning comes from one sentence at 18px set directly below the band at the left margin on the page ground, stating plainly who these names are. Supplied logos may replace names if all are available as single-colour SVGs at 0.8em height; do not mix logos and set names in one line. The band butts against the sections above and below with no gap.
sections.mobile: The band is 22vh tall with names at 15vw, still cropped at both edges and still moving. The explaining sentence sits under it at 16px with 20px margins. Do not add a second line running the opposite way; one line is the idea.

sections.name: Object on a disc
sections.blueprint: One section about a viewport tall on a plain ground. A flat filled disc 64vh across, in one palette colour, sits with its centre at 58% of the width; swap the disc for the subject's own shape if it has one. A cut-out object photograph stands in front of it, centred on it, about 78% of the disc's height and breaking the disc's outline at the top. Bottom-left, starting on the margin and ending level with the disc's lower edge: a vertical list of four to six item names at clamp(28px, 2.9vw, 44px), leading 1.15. The selected name is in full ink and the rest at 25%; choosing a name swaps the object (300ms crossfade) and the disc's colour. The heading, two to four words at the same size as the names but in the soft ink, is the first line of that list. One fact about the selected item sits at the disc's right edge at 17px.
sections.mobile: The disc comes first, 86vw across and centred, with the object in front. The names follow as a single sideways-scrolling line at 26px with 24px gaps, the selected one in full ink. The fact sits under the names at 16px.

sections.name: Wide heading, indented questions
sections.blueprint: A heading of three to five words at about 5.5vw runs from the left margin on one or two lines and is the only large thing in the section. 80px beneath it the questions begin, indented to start at column 5 and running to column 12, so the left third under the heading stays empty. Each question is a row at 22–24px in the regular weight with a chevron of two 2px strokes at the far right; rows are separated by 36px of space and no rules. Opening a row lays a tile of the one-step tone behind that row and its answer (24px padding, extending 24px beyond the text on both sides) and shows the answer at 17px with a 48ch measure. Six questions. Nothing else shares the screen; the indent against the wide heading is the composition. Build with `<details>`.
sections.mobile: The heading sits at 10vw on two lines. Questions lose the indent and run full width at 19px with 28px between rows; the open row keeps its tone tile, now bleeding to both screen edges, with the answer at 16px inside it.

sections.name: Visit card on a photograph
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph of the place, 100vw by 100svh, carries one solid card and nothing else. The card is a filled panel in the paper colour, fully opaque, 380px wide with 8px corners and 32px padding, placed in the upper-right corner 60px from the top and right edges (or the upper-left: pick the corner where the photograph is calmest). It holds, top to bottom: a two- or three-word title at 28px in a light weight; the address on two lines at 16px; the opening hours as three rows with days at the left and times right-aligned in tabular figures; the phone number; then, flush with the card's bottom edge and spanning its width, a solid booking button 52px tall. The card may be `position: sticky; top: 60px` inside a taller section so it holds while the photograph scrolls beneath it. The photograph's focal point must stay clear of the card. No heading outside the card.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 70svh. The card leaves the corner: it spans the width with 16px margins and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 80px, so image and card interlock. The booking button is full width, 56px tall, at the card's bottom.

sections.name: The back of the card
sections.blueprint: The footer is the reverse side of the page's artefact, laid out as the back of a postcard. A paper-coloured panel spans columns 2–11 on the contrasting ground, about 420px tall, its top edge cut into a row of twelve semicircular scallops (an inline SVG path or `clip-path`, each scallop about 100px wide). The panel is divided by space into two halves. Left half: a short sign-off of two to four words at 32px, then two or three lines at 16px, written like a message. Right half: the address block, four left-aligned lines at 18px with 12px between them, each line a link (email, telephone, street, social); above it in the top-right corner, a stamp: one small photograph, 3:4 and 88px wide, with a 6px paper-coloured margin. Along the panel's bottom edge, a single centred line at 12px gives the copyright like a printer's imprint.
sections.mobile: The panel runs full width with six scallops across its top edge. The stamp sits top-right at 64px wide; the sign-off and message come first, then the address lines at 17px beneath them, then the imprint line centred at 12px.

references.name: Plastic
references.idea: A plain, quiet app page given one physical object: a photographed vinyl record cropped by the top-right corner of the viewport.
references.hero: Pale grey page with no navigation, only a bold wordmark with a small orange-red caps descriptor beneath it at top left (80px margin). A photographed black vinyl record with an orange-red label is cropped by the top-right corner, showing a quarter disc about 360px wide and tall, with an orange wire stand poking out below it. The headline is centred slightly above the middle in two lines at 74px (5.2vw), about 37% of the viewport wide, followed by a two-line 17px sentence and two black store badges side by side. Lower down, an award mark and a laurel-framed rating sit centred; the bottom fifth is empty.
references.type: Archivo only. Headline weight 500, sentence case, tight leading, 74px against 17px body, about a 4.4x jump. Feature headings near 30px in two colours, a much larger heading in the dark section (digest peak 12vw), and tiny tracked caps in the footer.
references.colour: #f5f5f5 #d5d5d5 #090d0e #171615 #e0441c — Greys and near-black with one orange-red accent taken from the record label; it colours the logo descriptor and the first line of each feature heading. One near-black section breaks the light page.
references.imagery: Phone mockups with real app screens (album-cover grids, a camera view) sit inside mid-grey rounded panels and are cropped by the panel edge. The hero uses a cut-out photographed record with a soft shadow; album art supplies the colour.
references.layout: Centred hero, then feature rows on a wide container: a tall grey panel on one side and a short text block vertically centred on the other, sides swapping per row. A dark full-width section with offset white cards follows, then a narrow FAQ column and a sparse footer.

sections.description: Each feature is a two-column row. One column is a mid-grey rounded panel about 540px wide and 720px tall containing a phone mockup pinned near the top, with the next phone's top edge peeking in at the panel's bottom. The other column holds a two-line heading, first line orange-red and second near-black at the same size, over a three-line grey paragraph, vertically centred. The panel side alternates left and right.

A near-black full-width section opens with a large centred white heading. Below it, white rounded cards of different sizes are placed off-grid at staggered horizontal positions: one holds an album-cover collage with a record sliding out, with a bold white caption and a grey line beneath it on the dark ground; another is a small data card listing collection fields as label and value rows.

A left-aligned column about 480px wide, offset toward the page centre and headed by a bold short title. Six questions in small bold text are separated by hairlines, each with a plus sign at the right edge. A generous empty gap follows before a footer of three tiny caps link groups spread left, centre and right, small legal notes, and a pipe-separated caps link row.

steal: Crop one photographed physical object by a viewport corner so the hero has a subject without a centred mockup.
Set two-line feature headings at one size with the first line in the accent colour and the second in ink.
Drop the nav entirely on a one-page app site: wordmark plus a one-line descriptor top left, store badges directly under the headline.

references.name: Moto Finance
references.idea: A metal card presented like a museum piece: lit by a single overhead light box in a black room, then orbiting through dim architectural stills.
references.hero: Black full-bleed 3D scene. A pale silver-lavender light panel, a trapezoid in perspective like a ceiling light box, occupies the top 20% and centre 55% of the viewport. The two-line uppercase headline, centred at 4.4vw in medium grotesk with tight leading, straddles the panel's lower edge so its first line sits half on light, half on black. In the exact centre a small metal card stands on a low plinth, only about 150px wide, surrounded by darkness. A light-grey pill button (about 250 by 52px) is centred near the bottom; the logo is top-left and a dark pill button top-right.
references.type: Neue Montreal only: weight 500 uppercase at 64px (4.4vw) with near-zero tracking and leading under 1.0 for headings, 20px sentence case for body, tiny caps labels in the footer. Three sizes; centred until the left-aligned footer.
references.colour: #080808 #edefef #c4cbd6 #e1e5e5 #2a2f3a — Black with cool silver-grey and no brand colour at all. One section inverts to pale grey-white with grey type; the only chroma is amber city lights and a blue atmosphere rim on the globe.
references.imagery: Rendered chrome card with an embossed profile medallion, a night-side Earth, and small dim architectural and fashion stills floating as tilted panels in 3D. Everything underexposed, cool and low-saturation.
references.layout: Full-viewport scenes stacked one per screen, each with a centred uppercase heading, an optional short sub-line and a pill button. One light interlude breaks the black. The footer switches to a left-aligned statement with link columns at the far right.

sections.description: Centred heading at the top with a two-line grey sub-line and a pale pill button directly under it. The lower 45% is the top arc of a night-side Earth rising from the bottom edge, about 75% of the viewport wide, with city lights and a bright blue-white rim on the upper right. Three small dark capsule labels with check icons float over and beside the globe at staggered positions, like status notifications.

A dark 3D room: about twelve small photo panels (roughly 70 by 90px, each tilted at its own angle, heavily dimmed) arranged in two loose rows across the full width, receding with blur. The card stands edge-on in the centre, much larger, catching a specular highlight. Later the card faces front at top-centre and a centred two-line heading with a pill button sits under it.

A pale grey-white band. Two tall columns of currency amounts in mid-size light-grey sans, one at a quarter and one at three-quarters of the width, each fading to white at top and bottom like slot-machine reels, with the centre rows darkest. Between them, three short centred lines of small black text. The bottom edge of the band reveals a dark photograph.

steal: Let a headline straddle the edge of a light shape so one line is half on light and half on dark.
Show the product very small in a large dark space in the first viewport, then let it grow as the page scrolls.
Use vertically scrolling columns of real-looking figures, faded at both ends, as a quiet backdrop for a three-line statement.

references.name: Seasats
references.idea: Calm, dusk-lit seascapes sell autonomous boats as serene instruments, and the navigation is a column of stacked colour swatches taken from that sea-and-sand palette.
references.hero: A 10px white frame surrounds everything. The left 84% is one rounded media panel: a dusk scene of a low, solar-decked vessel centred on mirror-flat water, with two larger hulls cropped by the panel's left and right edges. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third, two lines of white light-weight flared serif at 124px (8.6vw). A wordmark in custom wide techno lettering sits top-left; a white rounded button with mono caps and a dark-green square arrow sits bottom-centre. The right 14% is the menu: a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks (blush, sage, then four darkening olives), each holding left-aligned 15px links, sub-items numbered 01 to 04.
references.type: seasonMix, a low-contrast serif-sans hybrid, light weight, sentence case, near-zero tracking, at 124px for the headline and about 40px for statements; seasonSans 16px for body and menu; supplyMono uppercase at 9 to 12px for buttons, tags and footer data.
references.colour: #a6b3bc #232323 #b7c8be #d6c4b8 #2c3620 #e2832a — Slate blues and lilac greys from the seascapes dominate; the menu adds blush, sage and olive blocks; the footer flips to a burnt-orange and rust scene. Text stays white.
references.imagery: Photoreal rendered footage of autonomous boats on glassy water at dusk: symmetrical, low horizon, lots of sky, full-bleed after the hero. Small square-cornered inset stills with mono tag labels float over the scene.
references.layout: Mostly full-viewport scenes with one centred text block each, at top or bottom, and the wordmark fixed top-left. Only the hero uses the framed panel-plus-menu split. A thin vertical progress line runs down the right edge.

sections.description: A pinned full-bleed scene shot from the boat's deck: the hull forms a dark symmetrical wedge rising from the bottom edge to a mast at centre, horizon at one-third. At top-centre six short statements are stacked, centred, at 16px; one is white and the others half opacity, and the highlight steps down the list on scroll. For each, small photo cards (150 to 220px wide, square corners, mono tag on the top edge) appear left and right of the mast.

A full-bleed aerial view of dark teal water with several small vessels scattered across the lower half and a faint horizon near the top. A single two-line statement in the light serif at about 40px sits centred near the bottom edge. Nothing else is on screen except the wordmark top-left and the thin progress line at right.

Colour inverts to a burnt-orange haze over rust-red terrain, with black silhouettes of hulls and a keel hanging from the top edge as if seen from below the surface. Mid-height: mono readouts at left reporting distance scrolled in metres and scroll speed in knots with a one-line quip; a link list at 16px in the centre; mono contact details at right. The wordmark fills the full width at the bottom, white, about 130px tall.

steal: Build the menu as a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks sampled from the imagery, grouping links by block colour instead of by rules or headings.
List every claim at once, centred and dimmed, and move a single full-opacity highlight through the list on scroll while supporting images appear around a fixed subject.
Give the footer its own opposite-temperature scene and a live readout of how far and how fast the visitor scrolled, in the product's own units.
